WITH filtered_item AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_manager_id
    FROM item
    WHERE ((i_category IN ('Books','Children','Electronics') AND i_class IN ('personal','portable','reference','self-help') AND i_brand IN ('scholaramalgamalg #14','scholaramalgamalg #7','exportiunivamalg #9','scholaramalgamalg #9'))
        OR (i_category IN ('Women','Music','Men') AND i_class IN ('accessories','classical','fragrances','pants') AND i_brand IN ('amalgimporto #1','edu packscholar #1','exportiimporto #1','importoamalg #1')))
),
date_range AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_moy
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq IN (1222,1222+1,1222+2,1222+3,1222+4,1222+5,1222+6,1222+7,1222+8,1222+9,1222+10,1222+11)
),
item_month_fact AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ss.ss_item_sk,
           dr.d_moy,
           SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS item_month_sales
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_range dr ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    JOIN store st ON ss.ss_store_sk = st.s_store_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_item_sk IN (SELECT fi.i_item_sk FROM filtered_item fi)
    GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, dr.d_moy
),
manager_month AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT fi.i_manager_id,
           imf.d_moy,
           SUM(imf.item_month_sales) AS sum_sales
    FROM item_month_fact imf
    JOIN filtered_item fi ON imf.ss_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY fi.i_manager_id, imf.d_moy
),
manager_avg AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT i_manager_id,
           AVG(sum_sales) AS avg_monthly_sales
    FROM manager_month
    GROUP BY i_manager_id
)
SELECT mm.i_manager_id,
       mm.sum_sales,
       ma.avg_monthly_sales
FROM manager_month mm
JOIN manager_avg ma ON mm.i_manager_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ma.i_manager_id
WHERE CASE WHEN ma.avg_monthly_sales > 0 THEN abs(mm.sum_sales - ma.avg_monthly_sales) / ma.avg_monthly_sales ELSE NULL END > 0.1
ORDER BY mm.i_manager_id, ma.avg_monthly_sales, mm.sum_sales
LIMIT 100

2. 3. DATE-RANGE PRE-MATERIALIZATION — TARGET: `date_dim.d_month_seq` condition — TRANSFORMATION: Materialize the `d_date_sk`/`d_moy` pairs for the 12 month-sequence values once into a small derived table/CTE, and join that compact set to the fact rows so the month filter and `d_moy` grouping key are resolved without repeatedly scanning `date_dim`.

4. POST-FILTER FACT PRE-AGGREGATION — TARGET: `store_sales` → `item` join feeding `GROUP BY i_manager_id, d_moy` — TRANSFORMATION: After the item/date-restricted scan, aggregate `ss_sales_price` by `(ss_item_sk, d_moy)` first, then join to `item` for `i_manager_id` and aggregate again to `(i_manager_id, d_moy)`; only the small monthly totals reach the analytic average and outer filter.
